errors.evidence: The description states the vertical axis range ends at 89, but the tallest bars for the 'LoRA' and 'S5-model' methods clearly extend above the implied 89 mark, reaching over 89.1.
The description states the 'base' bar for the 'Prefix' method is approximately 85.3, but it is visually one of the lowest bars on the chart, at a value of approximately 84.4.
The description states the 'large' bar for the 'Prefix' method is approximately 87.3, but it is visually below the 86 tick mark, at a value of approximately 85.6.

The 'large' bar for the 'S₅-model' method is reported as 88.7, but it is visually one of the two tallest bars, well above the 88 tick mark and close to the top of the chart at a value of approximately 89.2.
